title: Koolasuchus Named Victoria's State Fossil
content: Car-sized monster amphibian Koolasuchus has been chosen by public vote as the state fossil emblem of Victoria, Australia.It was one of the subjects of the "Australia's Age of Dinosaurs" stamp issue that I designed for Australia Post.Museums Victoria:Victoria's 'kool' new State Fossil EmblemKoolasuchus cleelandi
